integrations.description: Connect the services that local agents use to read repositories and open draft changes.
integrations.github_blurb: Bind projects to repositories and let agents open draft pull requests.
integrations.read_only: Only workspace admins can change these settings.

github.description: Bind projects to repositories, clone them on the Mini, and let agents open draft pull requests.

setup.title: Install the GitHub integration
setup.description: Plane uses a GitHub App that your workspace admin authorizes. Plane never stores your password.
setup.check_repositories: List the repositories the app has been granted
setup.check_bind: Bind one repository to each project
setup.check_pull_requests: Let agents open draft pull requests for review

device.instructions: Open {url} in your browser and enter this code to authorize Plane.

result.expired: The code expired before GitHub confirmed it. Start again to get a new code.
result.denied: GitHub did not authorize Plane. Start again if this was a mistake.

reconnect.connected_admin_lost: The admin who connected GitHub is no longer a workspace admin. Plane stopped using that token. Another admin must reconnect.
reconnect.generic: Plane cannot use the saved GitHub connection. Reconnect to continue.

errors.github_app_not_configured: The GitHub App is not configured on this Plane instance. Ask the instance admin to add its client ID.
errors.device_flow_disabled: Device flow is not enabled on the GitHub App. Enable it in the GitHub App settings.
errors.token_encryption_failed: Plane could not store the token securely. Nothing was connected.
errors.github_unexpected_response: GitHub returned an unexpected response. Try again.
errors.github_url_unreachable: Plane cannot reach GitHub. Check the network and try again.
errors.account_remove_failed: Plane could not remove the installation. It is still connected. Try again.
errors.github_revoke_failed: GitHub did not confirm that the token is revoked. GitHub is still connected. Try again.
errors.provider_disconnected: This provider is not connected in this workspace.
errors.provider_reconnect_required: This provider needs to be connected again.
errors.repository_already_bound: Another project already uses this repository. Choose another one.
errors.repository_unavailable: This repository is no longer available. Choose another one.
errors.repository_not_found: This repository is no longer in the catalog. Choose another one.
errors.invalid_base_ref: The base branch name is not valid.
errors.invalid_repository: The repository choice is not valid. Choose it again.

accounts.title: Connections
accounts.connect_organization_hint: Install the GitHub App on an organisation in the new tab, then refresh this list.
accounts.candidate_hint: Attach an installation to offer its repositories in this workspace.
accounts.personal_hint: Connected · used to authorize the GitHub App for this workspace
accounts.empty: No installations yet. Install the GitHub App on an account or organisation.
accounts.attached_toast: {name} is attached. Its repositories appear shortly.
accounts.remove_confirm_content: New projects can no longer use repositories from {name}. Projects already bound to one of them keep the binding for audit, but new Runs cannot use it. The GitHub App stays installed until you uninstall it in GitHub.
accounts.removed_hint: To uninstall the GitHub App, open the installation settings in GitHub.

connection.github_disconnect_confirm_content: Plane revokes this workspace's GitHub token and stops using it. Projects keep their repository binding for history, but new agent work and pending pull requests fail until GitHub is connected again.
connection.github_revoke_in_provider: Plane did not revoke the old token because it could not use it. Revoke it in GitHub under Settings, Applications, Authorized GitHub Apps.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: Repositories this workspace has been granted access to
repository.none_warning: Without a repository, an agent run will ask for one and cannot start its harness until you choose it.
repository.load_error: Repositories could not be loaded. Try again.
repository.not_connected_title: No Git provider is connected in this workspace
repository.not_connected_description: Connect GitHub to bind a repository to this project. You can also create the project now and choose a repository later.
repository.base_ref_hint: Agents start from this branch. Leave empty to use {branch}.

description.pull_request: Defaults for the pull requests that agents open from code jobs.

open_as_draft_hint.pull_request: Reviewers see the change as a draft until a person marks it ready.

mirror_conclusions.pull_request: Post run conclusions as PR comments

mirror_conclusions_hint.pull_request: The conclusion of each run is also posted as a comment on the agent's pull request.

policy.branch_format_hint: Each run gets its own branch. The run ID at the end keeps names unique, and a run keeps its branch when this format changes.
policy.save_failed: The setting was not saved. Try again.
